text: Disneyland, a theme park located in Anaheim, California, was conceived by Walt Disney. This list includes attractions such as rides, shows, shops, and parades that have permanently closed at the park, excluding character meets and atmosphere entertainment like roving musicians. It also does not include permanently closed attractions from Disney California Adventure. The Main Street Opera House has hosted various shows over the years. Bear Country opened in 1972, was renamed Critter Country in 1988, and was subsequently renamed Bayou Country in 2024.
